Today, Jennifer went to the orchestra hall. Between what times could they have gone?
We know that:
Jennifer woke up at 5am.
Susan saw Jennifer buying a bike at the bike shop from 5am to 12pm.
Jessica saw Jennifer working at the office from 12pm to 4pm.
Nancy saw Jennifer buying clothes at the mall from 5pm to 9pm.
The orchestra hall was closed after 9pm.
Between what times could Jennifer have gone to the orchestra hall?

Options:
(A) 12pm to 4pm
(B) 5pm to 9pm
(C) 4pm to 5pm
(D) 5am to 12pm

Think step by step about the question. Keep reasoning concise (under 300 words). Then give your final answer on the last line in exactly this format: Answer: (X)

- From 12pm to 4pm, Jessica saw Jennifer, so she cannot have been at the orchestra hall during this time.
- From 5pm to 9pm, Nancy saw Jennifer, so she cannot have been at the orchestra hall during this time.
